conditions.meaning: Reports whether the operator resolved its plan dependencies. Cancellation can also set this to true.
Reports whether the preparation bound its inputs. Read `status.resolvedPlanRef` to locate the plan.
Reports active work on bound inputs. Check `status.tables` and `status.graphSnapshot` for the current step.
Reports whether the operator verified the published graph snapshot. On success, read `status.outputs.graphSnapshot`.

example.introduction: A preparation that cannot load its plan reports the storage diagnostic in its dependency condition.
example.nextCheck: Inspect artifact storage access for the preparation. On recovery, check the plan reference and the child snapshot statuses.
example.title: When plan storage is unavailable

narrative: For `NeedsReview`, inspect `pinDiagnostic` and `lastPinMismatch`. Some branches write a phase and diagnostic before they refresh conditions. Compare the condition generation with the preparation generation. For a scheduling delay, inspect the SnapshotBuild named by the step’s `activeBuildRef`. A table alias or graph placement override takes precedence over `spec.execution.placementTemplateRef`.
